text: First day on the job
I need to use the light to guide the ships past all the objects.
It cannot be that difficult.
The faith they've put in me is absurd. I was forever losing my way as a boy.
God's wounds, the light won’t reach the ships. There has to be some way to redirect it.
Whole job’s just mirrors, redirecting the light inch by inch like I’m negotiating with the ocean.
One wrong angle and I'm guiding ships into the arms of Davy Jones.
One day they’ll invent a lighthouse that just points where it’s supposed to.
Oh look, a cannon! Hopefully, we're not going to need it.
Bloody pirates. Hats and everything. I’m deeply unimpressed.
Give us the rum and we'll go away.
Just kidding, we'll take the rum and sink your ship!
Hold on, of course I need the cannon. Come to the light you fools!
That is no ship. Whatever it is, keep it in the light.
Cannon, if you would.
Dim it a touch, old man! Trying to work here.
That's it. A new plan - we steal the lighthouse
There’s a rock out there covered in symbols, and I’m telling you it’s not decorative. Maybe I should shine the light on it.
Oh dear, the symbols are glowing. It activated a pulse
Wait... those symbols look familiar. This can not be a good sign.
I rise from the abyss, and for what? Pathetic.
Ph’nglui mglw’nafh… ehyeh nafl’zhroth vulgtlagln—shogg r’luhh y’hah!
My minions... Destroy… driftwood of men…
break them beneath the dreaming tide…
They cannot harm us. They cannot even be remembered. Break them. Let the sea take back what was never theirs.
Futile resistance. You strike, and we withdraw — but only as the deep withdraws before the greater wave.
We will come again, and again, until nothing stands to remember the struggle.
Good riddance.
That was quite… Are those runes glowing? ...Shogg’na thrii, ul’ghor ah
Wait what…? - shogg'nafh
Rhyleh shogg r’luhh
nafl'zhroth vulgtlagln
Oh no, they lost a ship!
I hope that was the only one... If they lost five ships, it would be a disaster.
Hei. Olen auttaja — testataan, että naama ja ääni toimivat.
Ja minä olen pelaaja. Placeholder-äänet voi korvata myöhemmin.
